connectClient.tokenIssuedBody: The copy buttons now include its full Authorization header.
connectClient.title: Client snippets
connectClient.aboutTooltip: Give this MCP gateway configuration to your tool. It does not give it access to Paperclip or skills; it only gateways calls between the client and the tools exposed here.
connectClient.description: Choose a client and copy a complete, authenticated configuration.
connectClient.issueBeforeCopyStart: Issue a token before copying a snippet; the full
connectClient.issueBeforeCopyEnd: header is required. Existing token secrets cannot be retrieved again, so only tokens issued in this page session can fill a snippet.
connectClient.noSnippets: No client snippets available for this gateway.
connectClient.treatLikePassword: Treat the token like a password. Anyone holding it can call the tools this gateway allows. Revoke it if it leaks.

editGateway.title: Edit gateway
editGateway.description: Change the label or the access profile that controls which tools this endpoint exposes.

selectOrganization: Select an organization to manage gateways.

helpers.signInExpired: Sign-in expired — reconnect to restore access.

list.title: Apps
list.intro: A gateway is one safe MCP endpoint that exposes only the apps you assign. Hand it to a client like Cursor or Claude Desktop.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, app, or owner
list.whyBody: You pick which apps go through it, who can use it, and how. Revoke the token, the whole gateway goes silent — no app-by-app cleanup.
list.emptyBody: Group your connected apps into one safe endpoint you can hand to a client, then revoke it in one move.

newGateway.description: One safe MCP endpoint that exposes only the apps in its access profile. Hand it to a client like Cursor or Claude Desktop.
newGateway.profileHint: The profile decides which tools this gateway allows. You can change it later.
newGateway.descriptionPlaceholder: Who this endpoint is for and when it should be rotated.
newGateway.noProfiles: Create an access profile under Advanced before adding a gateway.

appsTools.introWithProfile: These apps go through this gateway. The bound profile ({{name}}) decides which tools are allowed — {{tools}}. Change the profile under Advanced.
appsTools.introNoProfile: These apps go through this gateway. The bound profile decides which tools are allowed. Change the profile under Advanced.
appsTools.empty: No apps are assigned to this gateway’s profile yet.

activity.intro: Calls through this gateway from the last 30 days. Open a row to inspect its tool, redacted arguments, result, and decision.
activity.empty: No calls have gone through this gateway yet.

advanced.archiveWarning: Archiving takes the gateway offline for every client. Existing tokens stop working. Type the gateway name to confirm.
advanced.confirmAriaLabel: Type the gateway name to confirm archive

overview.toggleHint: Toggle the whole gateway off here.
overview.whoBody: Anyone holding an active token below, restricted by the rules in the bound profile.
overview.appsEmpty: This gateway’s profile doesn’t include any apps yet.

tokens.copyNowBody: Copy it now — you won’t see the full value again after leaving this page.
tokens.intro: Issue a reusable token for an external client. Its name is also used as the client label.
tokens.runtimeNote: Paperclip creates a fresh one-hour runtime token when an agent run starts, then revokes it when the run ends. Codex can receive the same gateway through both an app connection and the managed-gateway path, so one run may leave two revoked rows. These are audit history, not repeated manual tokens.
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.nameHint: Also used as the client label.
tokens.ownerNotePlaceholder: Who uses this token or why it exists
tokens.pendingBody: An agent created these tokens for you. A value is generated when you reveal it and is shown only once.
tokens.newBody: It is now available in Client snippets for a copy-ready configuration.
tokens.historyEmpty: No tokens have been issued for this gateway.
